title: Space bound for an embedded machine
statement: Let $m,k$ be natural numbers, let $S$ be a set, let $R$ be a machine with $m$ work tapes and Boolean symbols, let $\iota$ inject the $m$ tape indices into the $k$ tape indices, let $d$ be a configuration of $R$ on a Boolean input $x$, and let $t\in\mathbb N$. The machine obtained by embedding $R$, started from the configuration that embeds $d$ with every unused tape blank and its head at the origin, uses at most $k\bigl(\operatorname{space}_R(d,t)+1\bigr)$ total space through time $t$.
hypotheses_covered: $R$ is an $m$-tape machine over Boolean symbols
$\iota$ is an injection from $m$ tape indices into $k$ tape indices
$x$ is a Boolean word and $d$ is a configuration on input $x$
